subject: Frontline lift plan + QBR artifacts — action items and deadlines
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Briggs <tbriggs@enablement.io>, Helen Park <helen@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Frontline lift plan + QBR artifacts — action items and deadlines

Team —

Quick cross-functional check ahead of next week’s QBR (Acme launch window). High-level ask: we need a tight frontline lift plan (support + enablement + docs) and the QBR artifact bundle by EOD Wednesday so leadership has a consolidated package for review on Friday. Specific asks below — please respond with owner + ETA by EOD Monday.

1) Enablement: final demo script and 1-pager for CSMs; include 2-3 troubleshooting FAQs for common integration issues. (Owner: Marissa)
2) Support: on-call rota + escalation path for first 30 days; confirm SLA tiers and who owns page escalation. (Owner: Monica)
3) Docs: quickstart update + API change log; mark any breaking behavior. (Owner: Laura)
4) Pricing/ops: confirm final pricing table we’ll show in QBR slides and any committed credits/offers. (cc: Karthik)

Attachments: Frontline_Lift_Sprint.xlsx (tracking workbook), QBR_Artifacts_Checklist.md (artifact template), support_oncall_rota_v2.csv (draft rota).

External note: Helen / Tom — we’re aligning internal readiness around this plan. If there are any outstanding procurement or commercial items you need us to include in the QBR bundle, flag them here.

Key constraints: leadership expects consolidated doc + one-slide risk summary by Thursday COB. If there are gaps, call them out now so we can escalate.

Thanks —

Jasmine Liu
Senior GTM Program Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, Tom Briggs <tbriggs@enablement.io>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Frontline lift plan + QBR artifacts — action items and deadlines

On Sun, 29 Nov 2026 at 09:12 AM Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Quick cross-functional check ahead of next week’s QBR ...

Got it — taking point on enablement artifacts. Immediate items and plan:

- Demo script: will deliver draft by Tue 11/30 5pm PT. Will include 3 short flows (setup, common integration, failure mode).
- 1-pager for CSMs: draft Wed 12/1 morning; will use the attached checklist for formatting.
- FAQs: will enumerate top 6 likely issues (based on last pilot) and map ownership.

Blockers: need final list of endpoints from engineering that changed in the last build (Laura — can you confirm if the API surface changed since the last doc drop?).

I’ll update the Frontline_Lift_Sprint.xlsx as I make progress.

-Marissa
Director, Enablement
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Frontline lift plan + QBR artifacts — action items and deadlines

Jasmine / Marissa —

Pushing the pricing and ops confirmations through. Quick notes from my side:

- Pricing table: procurement sign-off pending (procure@acme-analytics.com); I’ve attached the current price matrix to the internal tracker. If Acme needs a committed usage tier to hit their internal spend targets, we should know by EOD Tuesday.
- Credits: leadership sign-off required for any >20% introductory credit — flagging to execs separately.
- DocuSign: I’ve requested the PO template from Acme; Helen, can you confirm if the copy Tom sent is the final version? Link in related_links.

Operational ask for Monica: please confirm the on-call handoff window during PST business hours and the first escalation contact (name + cell). That will go into the QBR SLA slide.

Karthik
Head of Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Helen Park <helen@acme-analytics.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Briggs <tbriggs@enablement.io>, procure@acme-analytics.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 13:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Frontline lift plan + QBR artifacts — action items and deadlines

Thanks, Jasmine — and thanks everyone for pulling this together. A few quick items from Acme:

- Procurement: I looped in our procurement mailbox; we will try to deliver PO terms by Wed EOD but may need one follow-up call on data residency language.
- Support SLA: Acme prefers a named escalation contact for 24/7 incidents that impact telemetry ingestion. We can accept on-call rota if a named contact is provided.
- QBR asks: please include a short performance baseline slide (latency / error rate) for the pilot week — even approximate numbers will help our executive team.

Also: Tom, I know enablement materials are being prepared — could we schedule a 30-minute walkthrough of the demo for our CSMs on Thursday morning?

Best,
Helen Park
Head of Customer Success
Acme Analytics
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Helen Park <helen@acme-analytics.com>, Tom Briggs <tbriggs@enablement.io>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Frontline lift plan + QBR artifacts — action items and deadlines

Thanks all — good momentum. Quick consolidated next steps and owners: 

- Marissa: demo script draft by Tue 11/30 17:00 PT; CSM 1-pager Wed 12/1 morning. Schedule walkthrough Thurs 12/3 09:30 PT with Acme CSMs (Tom to coordinate).
- Monica: confirm on-call rota (named escalation contact + cell) and SLA slide by Tue 11/30 COB.
- Laura: confirm API surface change status by Tue 11/30 noon; update quickstart accordingly.
- Karthik: confirm pricing/procurement status with Acme; keep me posted on any credit asks.

I’ll compile the artifact bundle and the one-slide risk summary once the inputs are in (target: Thu 12/3 12:00 PT). If anyone anticipates delays, ping me directly so I can surface to leadership.

Jasmine
Senior GTM Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Frontline_Lift_Sprint.xlsx, QBR_Artifacts_Checklist.md
